mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Verona City Hall with a Waning Gibbous moon phase. Please note the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. We are looking at an overnight low of 49 degrees with rain in the forecast.

City residents should remember that refuse and recycling is handled by Pellitteri Waste Systems, and you can find your specific collection calendar on the city website. Also, please note that the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do in our area. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, we have Yoga at Insight Wellness on November 2, followed by trivia nights at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's on November 4.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident from October 25 where officers were dispatched to a vehicle stopped at an intersection, resulting in an arrest for O W I.

Today's flavor of the day was Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is now closed for the night, but we look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10:00 AM when our flavor of the day will be Mint Explosion.
